page_title: IRN 0-1 USA | Iran v USA 29/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+10' Haji Wright (USA) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Alireza Beiranvand is alert and denies him.
90+10' Referee Antonio Mateu Lahoz signals NO PENALTY for Iran after a VAR review!
90+9' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Iran! Let's see what he decides.
90+9' PENALTY APPEAL after Mehdi Taremi (Iran) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
90+8' Haji Wright (USA) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
90+6' Abolfazl Jalali (Iran) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Antonio Mateu Lahoz didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90+3' The free kick finds Morteza Pouraliganji (Iran) in space in the box, but he can't keep his header down and sends it just wide of the left post from close range.
90+3' Ramin Rezaeian (Iran) will take the free kick.
90+3' Yunus Musah (USA) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Iran.
90+2' Abolfazl Jalali (Iran) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.

90' Ali Karimi (Iran) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Antonio Mateu Lahoz with no other option than to blow for a foul.
89' Saman Ghoddos (Iran) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
88' Morteza Pouraliganji (Iran) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
88' Shaquell Moore (USA) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
83' Ali Karimi (Iran) is put clear inside the box by a lofted pass. He only has the keeper to beat, but Matt Turner comes out bravely to save at his feet. Great goalkeeping skills!
83' Having seen unsporting behavior, Antonio Mateu Lahoz shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Hossein Kanaani (Iran) is the recipient.
82' Gregg Berhalter has decided to make a change. Walker Zimmerman (USA) replaces Timothy Weah.
82' Sergino Dest goes off the pitch and Shaquell Moore (USA) comes on.

81' Timothy Weah (USA) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Iran are awarded a free kick.
80' The attendance is 42127.

77' Ali Gholizadeh comes off the pitch to be replaced by Karim Ansarifard (Iran).
77' Majid Hosseini (Iran) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Antonio Mateu Lahoz had an easy-decision to make.
74' Looks like Joshua Sargent (USA) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

65' Mehdi Taremi (Iran) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.

62' Ramin Rezaeian (Iran) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
61' Weston McKennie (USA) trips an opposition player and Antonio Mateu Lahoz signals a foul.
60' Saeid Ezatolahi (Iran) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Antonio Mateu Lahoz blows his whistle for an infringement.
59' Flag up against Mehdi Taremi (Iran). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
57' Brenden Aaronson (USA) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

52' Saman Ghoddos (Iran) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar.
49' The resulting corner, taken by Brenden Aaronson (USA), comes to nothing.
49' Antonee Robinson (USA) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play. USA will have a chance to score from a corner.
48' A pass into the box finds Joshua Sargent (USA) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Alireza Beiranvand denies him.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Christian Pulisic (USA) comes off for Brenden Aaronson.
46' Carlos Queiroz has made a change at the break. Saman Ghoddos has come on in place of Sardar Azmoun (Iran).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.

39' Christian Pulisic (USA) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

36' Sergino Dest (USA) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. USA earn a corner.

33' Timothy Weah (USA) is put clean through inside the box by Joshua Sargent, but he gets right under the ball and sends it just over the bar. Should have been a goal!
32' Ahmad Noorollahi (Iran) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

28' That's unlucky! Joshua Sargent (USA) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
27' Christian Pulisic (USA) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
27' A lofted cross from Antonee Robinson (USA) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The linesman makes the right call and USA will have a corner.
25' Weston McKennie (USA) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
24' Timothy Weah (USA) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
23' Timothy Weah (USA) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
21' Mehdi Taremi (Iran) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.

19' Antonee Robinson (USA) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
17' Half-chance! Sergino Dest (USA) plays a pass into the box, but Alireza Beiranvand reacts well to snuff out the attack.
16' Antonee Robinson (USA) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
14' Joshua Sargent (USA) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

11' Christian Pulisic (USA) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Alireza Beiranvand, who pulls off a comfortable save!
10' Yunus Musah (USA) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
9' Sergino Dest (USA) serves up a nice cross, but Alireza Beiranvand punches the ball away.
9' Referee Antonio Mateu Lahoz sees the trip by Ramin Rezaeian (Iran) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
8' An attempted cross from Antonee Robinson (USA) is cleared.

5' Sardar Azmoun (Iran) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
